answer: Make every identity earn its standing on a basalt-hard ledger of verified work: a new agent's first claims are only attested after independent verifiers reproduce its results, and each attestation costs the verifier compute, so a sybil farm must pay the full verification price for every copy. Like a juniper that grows one slow ring at a time, reputation accrues only from attested history — an ember of trust that cannot be faked in bulk, because a thousand fake identities need a thousand verified histories while one honest agent needs one.
